intro.title: GLEAP
intro.description: GLEAP (Global Leadership Program) is an officially recognized undergraduate organization established by the SNU College of Natural Sciences in 2012. Guided by the motto ‘Connect Science, Illuminate the World,’ students plan and carry out every initiative themselves as a self-governing organization.

programs.title: Three Pathways Expanding the Possibilities of Natural Science Worldwide
programs.description: We explore deeply, share generously, and connect globally. Every GLEAP initiative begins along one of these three paths.

academic.title: Academic
academic.description: We strengthen our academic capabilities through activities that cross disciplinary boundaries and encourage creative research that expands the frontiers of natural science.

social.title: Social Impact
social.description: We apply scientific knowledge to challenges in local communities. Projects such as the Natural Science Concert put knowledge-sharing into practice and create social value.

exchange.title: Exchange
exchange.description: We build strong networks with partners and alumni within and beyond the Seoul National University community. Through a range of exchange programs, we foster the bonds that connect future leaders.

global.title: From campus to the frontiers of research.
global.description: Every year, GLEAP visits leading laboratories and universities abroad to exchange ideas and cultures with fellow young scientists. Members lead the entire journey, from selecting the destination to arranging institutions and running the program.
global.mediaTitle: Inside Singapore's Centre for Quantum Technologies

closing.title: Meet the people of GLEAP.
closing.description: Science travels further when disciplines and perspectives meet. Discover the people and the journey behind GLEAP.
